cases.title: Runtime compatibility gate | 运行兼容性门禁
cases.description: Pins the exact native generation and validates identity, ABI, architecture, manifests, runtime files, and safe loading. It does not prove SuperPoint or LightGlue accuracy. | 固定原生插件的精确 generation，验证身份、ABI、架构、manifest、运行文件与安全加载；不证明 SuperPoint 或 LightGlue 精度。

cases.title: Bounded worker protocol and stable feature IDs | 有界 worker 协议与稳定特征 ID
cases.description: Checks strict source/model/device/Pillow-decoder identity, the certified auto-to-CPU policy, explicit experimental MPS identity, bounded binary parsing, malformed-result rejection, match-index validation, and stable per-image indices without loading neural models. | 检查严格的源码/模型/设备/Pillow 解码器身份、已认证的 auto-to-CPU 策略、显式实验 MPS 身份、有界二进制解析、畸形结果拒绝、匹配索引验证及稳定的每图索引，不加载神经网络。
